disclaimer: Portfolio demos only. These workflows are original examples for demonstration. They are not client deliverables and do not represent work performed for any customer.

workflows.title: AI lead capture, enrichment, and scoring into HubSpot
workflows.description: A new lead is normalized, scored from firmographic and intent signals, written to HubSpot, mirrored to a sheet, and announced in Slack when the tier is SQL.

workflows.title: AI lead capture, enrichment, and scoring into GoHighLevel
workflows.description: The same capture-and-score path as the HubSpot demo, aimed at a GoHighLevel sub-account: contact, opportunity when the tier is SQL, sheet log, Slack ping.

workflows.title: Pipedrive deal from a web form
workflows.description: A web form creates a Pipedrive person and a deal, then posts the new deal title to Slack. The rules node sets the stage from the budget and source.

workflows.title: Salesforce lead from a marketing webhook
workflows.description: Normalizes a marketing webhook into a scored Salesforce lead and pings the SDR channel with the tier.

workflows.title: LinkedIn lead form into HubSpot and Slack
workflows.description: A LinkedIn lead-gen webhook is scored and written to HubSpot. Paid clicks with a buyer title are marked SQL.

workflows.title: Website chat lead into the CRM
workflows.description: A chat transcript is reduced to a lead record, scored, and only pushed to HubSpot when an email address is present.

workflows.title: Dedupe a lead before writing the CRM
workflows.description: Compares the incoming email to a known list on the payload and skips the CRM write when the lead is already there. New leads are scored and appended.

workflows.title: Outbound domain enrichment into the CRM
workflows.description: A domain and a guessed contact are scored and queued. The live branch can call an enrichment HTTP API before the HubSpot upsert.

workflows.title: Re-engage leads whose score has decayed
workflows.description: A weekly pass looks at a stored score and an age in days, drops the score, and drafts a re-engagement email when the lead falls out of MQL.

workflows.title: Fan a lead out to HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Sheets
workflows.description: One scored lead is written to a sheet and to two CRMs. Useful when a studio is mid-migration and both systems must stay current.

workflows.title: Stitch UTM attribution onto a CRM lead
workflows.description: Credits a lead's value to a campaign with a last-touch model, then writes the credited amount and the raw UTMs to HubSpot and a sheet.

workflows.title: Trade-show badge scan to the CRM
workflows.description: A badge scan from the show floor becomes a scored contact, a sheet row tagged with the event, and a Slack note for the rep who scanned it.

workflows.title: Speed-to-lead SMS and email inside 60 seconds
workflows.description: When a pricing or demo lead arrives, the workflow checks that it is still inside 60 seconds, assigns a named owner, and prepares the SMS and email that owner should send.

workflows.title: Missed-call text-back
workflows.description: A missed inbound call becomes an immediate text from a named owner, a sheet row, and a Slack alert. The copy changes if the call arrived after hours.

workflows.title: After-hours voicemail to SMS
workflows.description: An after-hours voicemail is transcribed into the sample text and answered with an SMS that promises the morning window, plus an email to the on-call alias.

workflows.title: Facebook lead ad instant reply
workflows.description: A lead-ad webhook is answered on WhatsApp inside a minute and logged to a sheet for the closer.

workflows.title: WhatsApp first response for a new inquiry
workflows.description: A new WhatsApp inquiry gets a named first reply and a HubSpot contact so the thread is not trapped in the phone.

workflows.title: Round-robin lead assignment with SMS
workflows.description: Leads are hashed onto a named owner, the owner is texted, Slack is posted, and the HubSpot contact carries the owner name.

workflows.title: Quote request with a calendar link
workflows.description: A quote request is assigned and answered by email with the next step, and Slack tells the owner. The calendar node is ready for a hold on the live branch.

workflows.title: Abandoned form recovery SMS
workflows.description: A form that captured a phone number but never a submit event is texted once, and the attempt is logged.

workflows.title: AI invoice and receipt extraction from Gmail to Sheets, Xero, and QuickBooks
workflows.description: A mailbox attachment is read as text, the vendor, invoice number, tax, and total are checked against each other, and a balanced bill is ready for Sheets plus either Xero or QuickBooks.

workflows.title: Receipt photo to an expense sheet
workflows.description: A photographed receipt, already reduced to text, is checked and appended to an expense tab. Unbalanced or merchant-less receipts are flagged in Slack.

workflows.title: Invoice approval routed through Slack
workflows.description: Bills under the auto-approve total are marked post. Larger or unbalanced bills are marked review and sent to Slack with the amount in the message.

workflows.title: Match a vendor bill to a purchase order
workflows.description: The extracted bill is compared with the PO amount on the payload. A mismatch becomes an exception row instead of a payment.

workflows.title: Reminder sequence for an unpaid invoice
workflows.description: An unpaid invoice is classified from its due date and a reminder email is drafted. The sheet records which attempt this is.

workflows.title: Extract key terms from a contract PDF
workflows.description: Contract text is scanned for the commercial numbers that legal and finance both ask for, and the row is flagged when the total does not match the stated subtotal.

workflows.title: Normalize a multi-currency invoice
workflows.description: A EUR bill is extracted, the original currency is preserved, and the sheet stores both the source total and a USD planning figure from the rate on the payload.

workflows.title: Vendor bill from email into QuickBooks
workflows.description: A vendor email becomes a balanced QuickBooks bill and a sheet row. Unbalanced extractions stay on the review route.

workflows.title: AI email triage with Gmail labels and drafted replies
workflows.description: Inbound mail is labeled billing, sales, support, or VIP, and a reply is drafted in Gmail. VIP mail is also posted to Slack. Nothing is sent automatically.

workflows.title: Newsletter digest posted to Slack
workflows.description: A newsletter is classified and reduced to a one-line Slack post so the inbox can be archived.

workflows.title: Classify replies to outbound email
workflows.description: A reply to an outbound sequence is marked interested, not-now, or unsubscribe, then logged. Interested replies are posted to Slack.

workflows.title: Shared inbox SLA timer
workflows.description: Mail is classified and the sheet stores the label. Slack is notified when the class is VIP or billing, which are the queues with a same-day promise.

workflows.title: Turn a Gmail thread into a ClickUp task
workflows.description: An email that is actually a request becomes a ClickUp task with the subject as the title and the body as the description.

workflows.title: Complaint and unsubscribe handler
workflows.description: Complaints and unsubscribe requests are separated from ordinary mail and logged. Complaints go to Slack immediately.

workflows.title: Pull a meeting request out of email
workflows.description: An email that proposes a time is turned into a calendar hold and a Slack note. The drafted reply confirms the slot.

workflows.title: Escalate mail from a VIP sender
workflows.description: Mail that mentions the board, legal, or an urgent keyword is labeled VIP and posted to Slack. Everything else is a normal draft.

workflows.title: Repurpose a blog or YouTube piece into LinkedIn and X drafts
workflows.description: A long source is cut into a LinkedIn draft, a short X draft, and a three-beat carousel. The drafts are logged and posted to Slack for approval. Nothing publishes itself.

workflows.title: RSS item onto a social queue
workflows.description: A new feed item becomes a queued social draft and a Slack nudge. The queue is the sheet.

workflows.title: Social mention into Slack
workflows.description: A mention payload is classified as praise, complaint, or question and routed to Slack.

workflows.title: Carousel outline from a blog post
workflows.description: A blog body becomes a three-beat carousel outline stored in a sheet for a designer.

workflows.title: Ask for a customer photo after delivery
workflows.description: A delivered order is turned into a short request for a photo, drafted in Gmail and logged.

workflows.title: Weekly social performance note
workflows.description: A week of post metrics is rolled into a short Slack and email note.

workflows.title: Hashtag research into a sheet
workflows.description: A caption is scanned for topic words and stored with the tags the draft should carry.

workflows.title: Podcast title ideas from a transcript
workflows.description: A transcript's opening line becomes a working title, a LinkedIn hook, and a short post. The producer gets the options in Slack.

workflows.title: Shopify order to Sheets, Slack, and fulfillment
workflows.description: A new Shopify order is classed as fulfill, VIP, refund, or fraud-review. The sheet always gets a row. Slack hears about VIP and exceptions, and the order node is ready to write a tag back.

workflows.title: WooCommerce order sync to Sheets and Slack
workflows.description: A WooCommerce order follows the same fulfill, VIP, and exception routes as the Shopify demo, with the store name stamped on every row.

workflows.title: Abandoned cart recovery email
workflows.description: A checkout that captured an email but no payment is logged and a single recovery draft is prepared.

workflows.title: Refund alert to Slack and Sheets
workflows.description: A refunded order is logged and announced. Paid orders stay quiet.

workflows.title: Low inventory alert
workflows.description: On-hand quantity and daily velocity become days of cover. Stockouts and reorder points are posted to Slack.

workflows.title: Review request after delivery
workflows.description: A fulfilled, paid order becomes a review request draft. Refunds and pending payments do not ask for a review.

workflows.title: Cash-on-delivery order verification
workflows.description: A cash-on-delivery order is texted for a yes before it is picked. Prepaid orders skip the text.

workflows.title: Roll two stores into one order sheet
workflows.description: Shopify and WooCommerce orders share one route and one sheet, with the store name on every row, so a daily Slack total is possible.

workflows.title: AI support ticket classification and routing
workflows.description: A ticket is classed as billing, technical, account, or general. The same decision opens a Zendesk ticket and a Freshdesk ticket so you can keep the desk you actually use, and Slack hears about technical and billing.

workflows.title: Follow up a CSAT detractor
workflows.description: A survey comment is classed, and anything that reads as a complaint gets a personal follow-up draft plus a Slack ping.

workflows.title: SLA breach warning
workflows.description: An open ticket with an age and a class is judged against a same-day promise. Technical tickets are the ones that page Slack.

workflows.title: Suggest a macro from the ticket text
workflows.description: The ticket class picks a macro family. The draft on the record is the suggested reply, posted to Slack for the agent.

workflows.title: Escalate an outage ticket to on-call
workflows.description: Technical tickets that mention an outage or a 500 page Slack and text the on-call number. Other classes stay in Zendesk.

workflows.title: Detect refund intent in a ticket
workflows.description: Tickets that ask for money back are separated from bugs and login issues and logged for finance.

workflows.title: Suggest a help-center article
workflows.description: A question is matched to a small local help set and the suggested article is posted for the agent. Unknown questions fall through.

workflows.title: After-hours ticket acknowledgement
workflows.description: A ticket that arrives after hours gets an acknowledgement draft that names the next window. The class is still stored so the morning queue is sorted.

workflows.title: Appointment booking with SMS and email reminders
workflows.description: A Calendly or Cal.com booking is turned into a 24-hour and a 2-hour reminder plan. SMS goes out when a phone exists, email otherwise. The calendar node can mirror the hold, and Slack sees the booking.

workflows.title: No-show recovery message
workflows.description: A booking marked no-show gets a short recovery note and a Slack line so the host can offer one new time.

workflows.title: Intake form before the appointment
workflows.description: An intake form is stored against the upcoming appointment and summarized for the host in Slack.

workflows.title: Send a reschedule link when a booking is canceled
workflows.description: A canceled invitee gets a reschedule draft and Slack is told the slot is free.

workflows.title: Group class roster to a sheet
workflows.description: Each booking on a group session is a roster row. Slack gets a one-line count when you roll the rows up.

workflows.title: Flag a booking that breaks the buffer
workflows.description: A new booking is summarized and Slack is warned when the payload says it overlaps the previous meeting's buffer.

workflows.title: Weekly KPI report to Slack and email
workflows.description: Monday morning numbers are summed, compared with last week, and written as a short Slack post and an email. The sheet keeps the totals.

workflows.title: Claude-ready CRM summary for the Monday dashboard
workflows.description: Pipeline totals are rolled into a briefing a Claude model can tighten on the live branch. The demo briefing is already a readable paragraph, so the Monday Slack post works before any model key is added.

workflows.title: Daily sales flash
workflows.description: A one-line daily sales flash: orders, revenue, and average order value versus yesterday.

workflows.title: Ad spend versus revenue digest
workflows.description: Spend and revenue are rolled up so the digest can show whether paid acquisition paid for itself this week.

workflows.title: Monday pipeline forecast email
workflows.description: Open pipeline, commit, and best-case are rolled into the Monday forecast email.

workflows.title: Support volume digest
workflows.description: Ticket counts by class are summed for the week and posted to the support channel.

workflows.title: Weekly churn-risk note
workflows.description: Accounts flagged at-risk are counted and the note names how many need a call this week.

workflows.title: Executive one-pager from a sheet
workflows.description: A handful of company metrics become a one-pager email and a short Slack trailer.

workflows.title: Slack message to a Notion page and a ClickUp task
workflows.description: A Slack message with an @owner and a due date becomes both a Notion page and a ClickUp task. Urgent words raise the priority.

workflows.title: Collect a standup into Notion
workflows.description: A standup message becomes a Notion page titled with the first line, assigned to the mentioned person.

workflows.title: Bug report from Slack to Jira
workflows.description: A Slack bug report becomes a Jira issue. Messages that say blocker or urgent are high priority.

workflows.title: Meeting notes to tasks
workflows.description: Notes pasted after a call are split into a task with an owner and a due date, then mirrored to Notion.

workflows.title: New-hire onboarding checklist
workflows.description: A new hire's name and start date become a checklist page, a Slack announcement, and a welcome draft.

workflows.title: Slack approval gate before a task is created
workflows.description: A request is parsed into a task and the summary is posted back to Slack. The ClickUp node waits on the live branch so a human can reject the demo result before anything is created.

workflows.title: Track a document request
workflows.description: An email asking for a document becomes a tracked row with an owner and a due date, and Slack is told.

workflows.title: Digest an incident channel
workflows.description: Incident channel messages are reduced to a timeline note with an owner, then stored in Notion and a sheet.

workflows.title: Web page scrape and enrichment into Sheets
workflows.description: HTML you already fetched is parsed for a title, an email, and a phone. Complete rows go to the sheet. Partial rows are kept and marked. The live branch can refetch the URL.

workflows.title: Job board posting onto a sheet
workflows.description: A job posting page is reduced to a title and a contact and appended when it is new.

workflows.title: Competitor price watch
workflows.description: A pricing page is stored with whatever commercial numbers the payload already parsed, and Slack is told when the route is complete.

workflows.title: Clean a directory listing
workflows.description: A messy directory row plus its HTML is normalized. Rows missing an email stay marked partial instead of being dropped.

workflows.title: Maps-style lead list into Sheets
workflows.description: A local listing that already includes a phone and a site is normalized and can be pushed to HubSpot when the email or phone is present.

workflows.title: Note a website's visible tech hints
workflows.description: A homepage is stored with its title and any contact, ready for a later pass that looks for script tags.

workflows.title: Aggregate public review snippets
workflows.description: A review snippet is classified as praise or complaint and stored. Complaints are posted to Slack.

workflows.title: Industry news item enriched for the team
workflows.description: A feed item is turned into a short social-style brief and logged, then posted to Slack.

workflows.title: AI agent with memory, a pricing tool, and a sheet tool
workflows.description: A question is answered from a local pricing book in demo mode. On the live branch an n8n AI Agent uses Groq, a short memory, a code tool for prices, an HTTP tool, and a Google Sheets tool, then posts the reply to Slack.

workflows.title: RAG knowledge-base chatbot
workflows.description: A question is answered from a tiny local knowledge set in demo mode. The live branch is a retrieval chain: Gemini embeddings, an in-memory vector store, a retriever, and a Groq chat model. An insert path is on the canvas for loading documents.

workflows.title: Research brief agent
workflows.description: A research question is answered from a local brief book in demo mode. The live agent can browse an HTTP tool and post the brief to Slack.

workflows.title: Sheet analyst agent
workflows.description: A question about the weekly numbers is answered from the rollup the payload already contains. The live agent can read the sheet.

workflows.title: Guarded email reply agent
workflows.description: A reply is drafted from a policy book. The live agent may call Gmail only to create a draft, never to send.

workflows.title: Internal IT help agent
workflows.description: An IT question is answered from a small runbook. Password and access questions hit the runbook. Everything else says it does not know.

workflows.title: Proposal draft agent
workflows.description: A proposal question is answered from the pricing book. The live branch uses Claude and posts the draft to Slack for a human to edit.

workflows.title: Researcher agent hands off to a writer
workflows.description: A research note is stored and a writer-ready summary is produced. The live canvas has an agent plus a sheet so the research and the draft are separate records.

workflows.title: CV parsing and candidate scoring into a sheet
workflows.description: A resume's text is scored against must-have and nice-to-have skills. The route is screen, hold, or reject as a recommendation. The sheet is the lightweight ATS, and Slack hears about candidates worth a screen.

workflows.title: Schedule an interview from an application
workflows.description: A candidate who already scored as a screen is offered a calendar hold and a confirmation draft.

workflows.title: Candidate nurture note
workflows.description: A candidate on hold gets a nurture draft instead of silence. The sheet records the touch.

workflows.title: Offer-letter data pack
workflows.description: A candidate who cleared the screen is packaged as an offer data row: role, score, and the fields a letter needs. Slack asks a human to approve before any letter is drafted.

workflows.title: Employee referral into the candidate sheet
workflows.description: A referral form is scored with the same rubric as a direct applicant and logged with the referrer's name.

workflows.title: Rejection note with specific feedback
workflows.description: A candidate the rubric marks reject gets a draft that names the missing must-have skills. A person sends it.

workflows.title: Stripe charges versus the bank, with a sheet of exceptions
workflows.description: Stripe charges are matched to bank lines on amount and currency within 50 cents. Matches are counted. Leftovers on either side become the exception report in Sheets and a Slack summary.

workflows.title: Failed payment dunning sequence
workflows.description: A failed charge is placed on step 1, 2, or 3 from how many days have passed. The email is drafted. The last step is marked final.

workflows.title: Weekly MRR snapshot
workflows.description: New, expansion, contraction, and churned MRR are summed for the week and posted.

workflows.title: Flag an expense that breaks policy
workflows.description: An expense is approved, sent back for a receipt, marked as an exception, or rejected based on category caps and the merchant.

workflows.title: Stripe payout lines onto a sheet
workflows.description: A payout's charges are matched to the expected deposit. Anything left over is the sheet finance opens.

workflows.title: Tax-ready monthly export
workflows.description: A month of revenue and tax collected is rolled up and emailed as the packet an accountant asked for.

workflows.title: Match an invoice to a payment
workflows.description: Open invoices are matched to payments on amount. Unmatched invoices stay in the exception list.

workflows.title: Vendor spend anomaly
workflows.description: This month's vendor spend is compared with last month. A jump is visible in the signed delta and posted to Slack.
